target_customer: Insured patients booking doctor visits, and providers who want guaranteed payment
problem: Patients get surprise bills because out-of-pocket cost is unknown at booking, and providers struggle to collect patient balances.
business_model: marketplace with provider-paid booking fees and guaranteed patient payments
product_category: healthcare booking marketplace with cost prediction

founders.name: Kevin Chiu
founders.background_notes: YC page: seven years at Uber, founding member of Uber Health.

founders.name: Daryl Sew
previous_startups: YC backed food delivery marketplace that reached 4M USD GMV
founders.background_notes: YC page: six years applying AI to self-driving cars. Crunchbase snippet lists him as CTO.

competitors.name: Sesame
competitors.what: marketplace with upfront cash prices and no insurance

technical_complexity.rationale: Predicting out-of-pocket cost per plan and procedure needs insurance data and models, hard for two founders but feasible.

defensibility.rationale: A cost prediction model could become a data asset, but a marketplace was copyable by Zocdoc and others.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. Zocdoc remained a large marketplace.

market_need_then: The No Surprises Act took effect in 2022 and surprise billing was a visible public pain point at the time.

branding.domain_note: Used certainlyhealth.com, which now redirects to certainlyglow.com.

brand_strength.rationale: Only funding press and directory listings found, nothing about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Certainly Health raised a 2.3M seed in December 2023 after the batch, with the founders bringing Uber Health experience. The company website now redirects to certainlyglow.com, which suggests a change of business or brand, but no source explains it, so the outcome is unclear and no failure is claimed.
notes: Seed confirmed by a press release and two outlets. Aggregators list conflicting totals (2.8M) and investors, left out as unverified. certainlyhealth.com 301 redirects to certainlyglow.com, cause not found. Outcome search found no shutdown or acquisition news. Competitor dates for Zocdoc not established. Undated competitor omitted from the list: Zocdoc.
